response.query: What numeric SNR and artifact tolerance thresholds (quantitative dB/SNR or signal-quality indices) will define acceptable recordings, and how will we simulate realistic noise (wind, clothing, talking, motion) and sensor displacement?
response.answer: Acceptable recordings typically have SNR thresholds above 30 dB, while realistic noise simulation involves using sound level meters to mimic environmental factors like wind and motion. Sensor displacement can be simulated using vibration analysis equipment.
